method: Call exact source evaluator; this table documents scope, not a handported evaluator implementation.

predicates.required_behavior: Fresh real verify_identity_files(verify_installed=False, require_root_controlled=True), enforce_vps_paths, canonical load and verify_vps_identity_permissions. Rehash retained wheel/lock/config/unit and sidecars; only installed distribution/RECORD scanning is reused from the early attestation.

No second installed package/RECORD forest scan. Earlier full canonical READY identity evidence must contain its real exact-match/artifact proofs and agree with the current identity object and guards. Keep original evidence under a reused-static reference, never present it as newly scanned.

Call real source verify_vps_control_chain with the earlier verified installed_artifact path mapping; freshly inspect controlling directories, canonical Python, wheel/lock/module/direct_url protected files. This is fresh namespace protection, not fresh all-file content verification.
Use the real source manager; current service principal, canonical Python/config/data/unit paths, ownership, mode and root-controlled executable/deployment directories must pass.

Real source current effective identity, drop-ins, environment files/pass environment, dependencies, executable/user/group/restart/stop/UMask/routing constraints and equality with identity.systemd_effective. Never cache this result.
Real runtime_properties; failed service => FAILED, not active => NOT_READY; positive integer MainPID required. Wrapper additionally binds expected invocation/NRestarts0/boot before and after.

Keep the original source provider/default. Read the actual current Recorder PID environment within the source1MiB bound; malformed/duplicate/active proxy or BINANCE_MARKET_RECORDER_* operational variables fail. Preserve only source-returned names/status; do not dump environment values.
Keep real current source read/schema handling. Missing/invalid state cannot pass; retain source result and a matching strict raw publication witness.
Published integer PID must equal live MainPID; use original real process_alive default, never cached/alwaystrue.
Published heartbeat integer and positive numeric nonbool interval as exact source requires.
Fresh source UTC now; source maximum_age=max(30s,3*published interval), future>5s and stale observations reject. Existing strict auxiliary heartbeat is still the tighter private gate.
FAILED service state fails; RUNNING is required; STARTING/other states cannot grant completion.
Exact published identity map must equal current identity_sha/source_git_sha/wheel_sha/config_sha/systemd_unit_sha/capacity_profile. This closes the demonstrated mismatched-publication bypass.
Current capacity_profile_id must match VPS_PRODUCTION_V1.profile_id.
catalog_open must be True and startup_recovery_complete must be True. Do not infer them solely from an old READY result.

Earlier unchanged full canonical CLI used the default real Catalog.integrity_check. Later guarded callback validates same-attestation/scope/boot/process/identity/clock and canonical same-file identity before returning its reused boolean. No fresh integrity result is claimed; no unconditional True or fake current scan.
Real source validates dict/allowed market/symbol types and exact configured four-product topology, with no missing/extra product.
Every current product object must be a dict with the correct market/symbol.

Current product failure must be None for this source readiness endpoint. Existing private write-safety additionally rejects true FAILED and preserves recoverable warm-loop behavior; do not relax either contract.
Current ready True; connected_streams/persisted_streams typed lists containing all CORE_STREAMS; snapshot_persisted and orderbook_synchronized True.
Current dict; observed timestamp/total/free are source-valid integers, total>0 and0<=free<=total.
Current capacity observed_at is neither too old nor>5s future under the same source maximum_age. This closes the stale-by1h bypass.
Current capacity.capacity_profile must match the source VPS profile.
State must be one of the exact source NORMAL/WARNING/CRITICAL/EMERGENCY/HARD_RESERVE values. FORECAST CRITICAL alone is not actual reserve exhaustion.
Source free<=HARD_RESERVE_BYTES or HARD_RESERVE state prevents READY. Keep private actual_hard_reserve_reached and fresh filesystem free-space guards as additional checks.

Only source stateREADY with no blocking source result allows conditional completion; keep exact source reasons/evidence unchanged inside an explicitly scoped wrapper. No wait_for_readiness polling or second full CLI at end/start.
Unchanged all14 flags/four products/26 strict auxiliary contexts, freshness/cursors and exact same raw publication witness; no dilution by completion probes.

Unchanged current AND peak ownedSwap0, RSS/hostavailable/filesystem reserves, trusted writes, boot/config/identity/invocation/PID/NRestarts/service-instance checks and fixed window. No birth/counter-only lineage claim.
